name: 78040 · Laredo, TX
findings: ZIP 78040 (Laredo) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78040 (Laredo) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78040 (Laredo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
